name: zinterp_context_constructor
description: zInterp_Context::Constructor initializes the context vtable/state, creates the scroll sentinel, allocates zeroed runtime storage, duplicates path strings, and prepares script-index state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
The source uses a symbolic vtable marker instead of the original raw image vtable address; tier S class/source-cluster work must replace this with the final rebuilt vtable symbol.
Binary Ninja renders compiler SEH setup and the byte copy into searchPathLeadChar as explicit compiler artifacts; source uses equivalent original-era constructor structure.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0d20 validates allocating a 12-byte self-linked scrollAlways sentinel, setting the zInterp_Context vtable, clearing includeDepth/currentNode/conditionalDepth/tempAlloc/hasPreparedInput/tokenCount/logFn/state/scrollAlwaysDriverNode, allocating and zeroing 0x1d8 bytes of runtime storage, duplicating search and prepared-index paths, clearing archive/file/prepared/macro/var/pointer-array fields, allocating preparedEntryCount, storing zero into it, and returning this.
The native smoke verifies the initialized fields, copied path strings, self-linked sentinel, zeroed runtime blob, prepared-entry count allocation, and then tears the context down through Destructor.
